inspiration: Dialogue pages are plain text in a small set of tags: a coloured title line, one-line-per-step tutorial text, and a link to advance. A simple in-game panel with the same rhythm could be drawn in our own style.

Icons are looked up by a key (a named icon from one shared texture sheet) rather than stored per item. Recreate with our own atlas and a key per item or skill. See Tools/BuildDataPackDb/Services/IconService.cs.

Zones are authored as shapes from nodes: a square from 2 points, a polygon from 3 or more, a cylinder from 1 point and a radius. A clean trigger-volume model for zone debug views. See DataPack/zones/documentation.txt.

Equipment slots are a fixed vocabulary (right hand, left hand, chest, legs, feet, head, gloves, two ring slots, two earring slots, back, waist and so on). Useful to define our slot list and to show two-slot rings as two icons. See DataPack/stats/items/documentation.txt.
Shop and exchange lists are data files with a readme index of what each number means. Good template for our loot and vendor data layout. See DataPack/multisell/readme.txt.

Augmentation options are named stat-modifier entries with a comment giving the effect in words. Could drive a tiered glow or sheen palette on gear, drawn from our own shader and palette ramps (no visuals ship here).

briefs.label: Saddle-beast form (own label)
briefs.why: A whole-body shapeshift into a mounted beast with its own movement set. Reads as a clear silhouette change from the player body.
keep: whole-body swap into a mounted silhouette
separate movement and speed profile for the form
a form that gates which actions are allowed
change: different proportions: longer neck, shorter legs
a palette of our own, not the donor's colours
a harness and ornament design of our own

briefs.label: Rune-etched gear tier (own label)
briefs.why: Stat-option tags are a compact vocabulary that can map to a visible tier. The donor files give only the stat text, so the look must be ours.
keep: named option entries with one stat each
a comment that says the effect in words
change: visual tier from our own shader ramp, not text
our own rune shapes instead of any donor icon
an animated seam rather than a static tint

briefs.label: Elemental imbue (own label)
briefs.why: An item carries an elemental tag with a level, stored per item. A tinted imbue on the blade reads at a glance in the fight camera.
keep: level shown as strength of glow
change: our own element palette and particle shapes
imbue shown as a frost or ember trail, not a flat overlay
level shown by ring count, not a number

briefs.label: Step-by-step tutorial panel (own label)
briefs.why: Short lines shown one at a time with an advance control. Good for onboarding, and easy to make in our own voice.
keep: an advance link at the end of each step
the first step names the place
change: a side-card with a portrait of our NPC
steps shown as a route on the map

briefs.label: Trigger volume set (own label)
briefs.why: Three volume types (box, polygon, cylinder) cover most zone shapes. Visualising them as translucent shapes helps level designers.
change: soft edges instead of hard boxes
